turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's Arabic language support been for your news content?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's usable but diacritics handling is inconsistent — the same word can be pronounced two different ways depending on context, and the model doesn't always pick correctly without us pre-annotating text.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is that a blocker for going all-in on the platform?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: For now yes, we're running a hybrid workflow with human voice talent for anything ambiguous. If Arabic diacritic handling improved, we'd move fully over.
